brief: The canvas displays a floating sheet of music, visible through five parallel lines, upon which various musical notes drift and travel. These notes, rendered in dark ink, continuously appear on one side of the page and fly gracefully across to dissipate on the opposite side. The movement is asynchronous, giving the illusion of a perpetual, unfolding melody. The entire composition should feel suspended in an ethereal space, constantly moving yet visually stable.
prompt: a series of musical notes flying across a music sheet floating in the air
statement: This sketch creates an ethereal musical composition where notes drift gracefully across a floating sheet of music. The piece visualizes the continuous flow of melody through five parallel lines, with each note appearing on the left side and flying across to disappear on the right. The notes vary in size, speed, and opacity to create a sense of movement and depth, while maintaining a stable, serene composition that feels suspended in space. The asynchronous motion gives the illusion of an endless, unfolding musical narrative.
